q: Talk on the sub's usual subject during the window (the game, team, show, place or hobby; its news, help and arguments), or ordinary side talk inside a canvas thread, with no canvas work and no April Fools joke as its point.
w: 'Idea for new 3rd jersey' answered 'We need to get a bigger space tbh': the words do not show whether the jersey design is meant for the canvas (T3-004, reader B) or is ordinary team talk (T3-017, reader A and my B1), and the image is not in the record.

Leaving the chaotic top corner, a site away from 'an absolute war zone' and a quieter spot over the Texas flag choose where to build (T3-020, reader B and my B1). A small Keyblade 'we can easily maintain' and 'keeping it small and simple' cut the design to the hands, counted under T3-004's 'size' by the reading on cut-down designs (reader A; my B1 had T3-069). Asking r/GreenLattice to let them in and showing how little space it needs ask a host for room (T3-035, my B1).

Niko's sprite, the laughing sprite and the plan fitted to Place's colours settle the look (T3-004, all three placements); 'we can build it right here' and the start by the Switch logo choose the spot (T3-020, both readers). 'since last night it got taken. RIP' and 'being taken over by the void... We're gonna need a safer spot' are new spots after the work was overrun, which T3-020's discriminator gives to T3-022 (named by neither reader).

Where the Sabres mark goes leads: above or below, a big empty splotch, 'right above the maple leafs logo', the space below that avoids the pbjt banana (T3-020, reader A and my B1). BuffaSlug or a goathead and a gold 15 offered before any mark stands (T3-033), a yellow 15 with a white background and a black border (T3-004, reader B), and 'say where', 'I need cordinates' (T3-034) each have three concepts of their own, as reader A's bag lists.

The flag's route leads: which way it should go, around the prism, skipping the rogue rainbow road, 'reaching all four corners', 'Advance to the north' (T3-020, all three placements, ten concepts). Stripe height, colours and the vertical look settle the design (T3-004, reader B and my B1); construction plans, the weave how-to and heart references are directions (T3-070, reader B and my B1). Two of three placements put the design second.

The bottom right or checkered green zone, an American flag where they wanted to go, and the attempt moved 'to avoid overwriting an american flag' choose the spot (T3-020, all three placements). The outline first and arms and money flying settle the look (T3-004); templates made and offered, and a warning not to click one, are directions (T3-070, reader A and my B1).

q: Proposing that the room make a mark at all (T3-033); choosing where it goes (T3-020); holding everyone to a chosen template (T3-091); reshaping the mark against tampering (T3-055); a bigger or second piece (T3-041).
w: Words and figures for the Austrian flag lead: Mörtl's face, a label underneath, 'Oida', AUSTRIA in red-white-red, Kaiser Franz with 'Österreich-Ungarn' united (T3-113, my B1), by the reading on the homeland flag; both readers had T3-004. 'r/AEIOU' above the flag writes the sub's name (T3-169, my B1). 'irgendein hirni malt immerwieder ne spastika hin' (some idiot keeps drawing a swastika) with ASOV to be erased covers a hate symbol (T3-146, my B1).

A new plan moving the CU logo up and 'This should be what we go for' work the standing logo's layout (T3-004, reader A), not a first mark (reader B's T3-033). Making room 'for everyone in our little spot' and backing off the expanding US flag spare others' work by the room's own choice (T3-024, named by neither reader); no deal is struck, so not T3-010 (reader B), and no one asked them to move (my B1 T3-039). Helping maintain the DU and CSU logos 'as a show of good faith' is T3-011.

All three placements stayed in G07. The trench war on the German-French overlap is ended by peace operations: 'Stoppt diesen Irrsinn', Operation Peace and Love, 'Nie wieder Krieg - Plus jamais la guerre', Operation Gute Nachbarschaft, 'Make EU not War' (T3-149, named by neither reader). The EU flag in the overlap, a shared beer with Belgium and a joint bratwurst (T3-056), the Bundesadler, beer and a pretzel on the flag (T3-113), and hearts joining Germany and France (T3-079) each have three concepts of their own: four themes, a bag.

Both readers flagged a bag. Once 'Police State' stands, sixteen concepts add to it: coins, the site favicon, a Giant Bomb logo beside it, Ryan's head, 'FUCK RYAN DAVIS' or 'LOVE RYAN DAVIS', RUN BFG (T3-041, by the reading that T3-033 is the first mark; reader A had T3-033 first). The letters' height and the tongue (T3-004, reader B), templates and pixel mappings (T3-070), first pixels and 'Doing my part!' (T3-038, my B1), and the move after the bomb was covered (T3-022) each have three concepts of their own.

q: Complaints that the room lacks coordination: too many threads, coordinates or designs at once; no one keeping one plan up to date; members unsure where the work is.
w: 'Wow what an original idea.' answered 'Hey man, I didn't know.' The proposal mocked is not in the item. The mockery neither offers a mark (T3-033, reader A) nor argues a design (T3-004, reader B), and one jab at a duplicate falls short of T3-049's complaint that the room lacks coordination (my B1).

Dan Gheesling, 'dan gheesling or nlsscircle jerk' and an egg with a face are subjects offered before one is chosen (T3-033, reader B), by the boundary ruled once; spelling it out, 'just DNA' and the colours available are versions of the chosen subject (T3-004, reader A and my B1). 'Right overtop of the Swedish flag', 937, 372 and 'i will find a spot' choose the spot (T3-020, my B1).

Beside the standing hammer and sickle and CCCP, thirty-nine concepts propose more: a petition to write 'KILL COPS', 'BASH THE FASH', 'GOOD NIGHT WHITE PRIDE', Marx, Che, a Stalin portrait for 'tankies', a Castro tribute, the YPG/J and Palestinian flags, ACAB (T3-041, by the reading that T3-033 is the first mark; reader A had T3-033). Flags under way at coordinates (T3-038, my B1), resizing and corrections (T3-004, reader B), calls for help (T3-002), and a larger CCCP 'to make it harder to vandalize' (T3-055) each have three concepts of their own: a bag.

q: An idea of what the room should put on the canvas, offered to the room
w: Vivec is proposed and drawn (T3-033, reader A and my B1); once he stands, CHIM under him and further wards against 'casu-els' are further pieces (T3-041, named by neither reader), by the boundary ruled once. Red Mountain or Dagoth Ur, N'wah and a Morrowind logo put on top of the Skyrim logo alter a neighbour's mark into the room's own (T3-068, named by neither reader). The border and r/trueSTL have two concepts each.

The logo thrown together, modified for the limited space and its border moved settle the look (T3-004, reader B and my B1); 'rally behind this spot' and a spot that reuses red and white choose where (T3-020, reader B). 'Do we want to try to expand' answered 'leave it as it is, otherwise it will be too hard to maintain' puts upkeep first (T3-042, my B1). The opening call is one concept (reader A's T3-033).

A rule for seed highlights, 'they should be plain brown', a grey border continued against objections and a black pixel skin settle the avocados' look (T3-004, reader B), the larger share. The big guy's location, the template being deviated from and a baby avo template are directions (T3-070, reader A's also_present); 'the text is pretty much done' and help asked filling the grey background report the build (T3-038, reader A and my B1). The sign that directs friends to the sub and r/avoarhy made for misreaders have two concepts each.

Making the lower right symmetrical, the reference picture and a two-pixel outline settle the look (T3-004, all three placements). 'I've started at location 160, 390' and building one pixel at a time place the mark (T3-038, reader A and my B1); keeping the black L as the point to count from and 'Count your pixels from the inside line of the C' tell placers how to follow the template (T3-070, my B1).

Both readers flagged a bag. The redesign leads: the 'final final' design, the neck regretted, settling for a logo 'before we pissed off Dota and Csgo' (T3-004, reader B). The logo done after ten hours (T3-038, reader A and my B1), calls to paint it next to Dota (T3-002), 'Stop doing the outline!' and 'Check the template' (T3-091), 'seduce me', a Scout and NOPE added (T3-041), 'remove SEDUCE ME in favor of r/tf2' (T3-169) and start pixels (T3-070) each have three concepts of their own.

A new spot in the Danish flag's red area, its top left at (288,61), the void that destroys what is drawn, and a black space choose where (T3-020, my B1), the larger share. The sign's padding, the truck's border and background and a design 'we can maintain with our small sub' settle the look (T3-004, reader B and my B1); SKULE under the box, a brown food truck and an RU tribute are further pieces (T3-041, named by neither reader). Reader A's T3-038 has two concepts.

Both readers flagged a bag. The Vineshroom under way, 'Just helped!' and the remaster done report the work placed (T3-038, reader A). 'vinesauce' written right of the shroom and r/vinesauce on Mega Man's laser write the sub's name (T3-169, named by neither reader); project 'Sauce' and THE DUANE are further pieces (T3-041, both readers' also_present and my B1); the template and coordinates are directions (T3-070, my B1). The four tie at three or four concepts; reader A's primary leads.

Objects put beside the figure are further pieces: Brimstone in the free brown area, Mom's Knife at 207,149, Guppy, a Crooked penny, 'FUCK BLOAT' (T3-041, reader B and my B1). Details on Isaac himself, wings, glasses, a halo, a crown, blue tears, shading and turning him into Azazel, are the figure's look (T3-004, reader A and my B1), as the boundary ruled once splits them. The mouth completed and 'go for the whole body' build the first figure (T3-038, my B1).

q: Is the mark's own design settled (T3-004), or a bigger or second piece added (T3-041)?
w: A gun made from the RIP sign, laser beams, the catchphrase written on the beam and 'a little weapons to shoot back at the megamans' are pieces added beside Dat Boi: T3-041 by the boundary ruled once (reader A and my B1); reader B read them as T3-004's design. Megaman is shot in the picture only; no pixels of another room's work are attacked in the words, so my B1 T3-006 drops. 'the megaman fascists removed it' blames the loss in one concept.

A transport belt added around the Factorio mark, curved over the prequelmemes box, spaghettied to the second Factorio and run underground is a further piece (T3-041, both readers); arrow spacing, yellow, red or blue belts and the corner reference settle its look (T3-004, both readers). Both readers held the same two themes. My B1 T3-038 rests on the start from convenient yellows.

The Beast's vomit is pushed onto the transgender flag, the pee stream onto Mario, and the body into the Void: 'TAKE THE VOID FOR QUEEN BEAST' (T3-061, my B1). T3-041's discriminator asks 'Does the room grow into empty space or onto its own work (T3-041), or into a neighbour's space (T3-061)?', and reader A placed the growth as T3-041. Titties kept, a fire-spewing butt, the eyes and a feminine touch settle the figure's look (T3-004, reader B). 'the monster is not so coordinated (and that's its beauty)' is one concept.

Double hearts above the Tenth Doctor, BAD WOLF in tiny letters and a sonic above Tennant are pieces added beside the picture (T3-041, reader B); 3D glasses on Ten and the DR moved a pixel are the figure's look (T3-004, all three placements), as the boundary ruled once splits them. 'Complete!' and 'As close to complete as we have probably ever been' report the build (T3-038, my B1).
